segments.name: Southeast
segments.description: Designs, builds and sells single-family homes to entry-level and empty-nest buyers across divisions in Atlanta, Central Georgia, Charlotte, Greenville and Raleigh.
segments.evidence: Our Southeast segment consists of our Atlanta, Central Georgia, Charlotte, Greenville, and Raleigh divisions.

segments.name: Central
segments.description: Designs, builds and sells single-family homes to entry-level and empty-nest buyers across divisions in Alabama, Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, Nashville and the Alabama Gulf Coast.
segments.evidence: Our Central segment consists of our Alabama, Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, Nashville, and Alabama Gulf Coast divisions.

revenueModel.text: Homebuyers pay the company for single-family homes, with revenue recognized at home closing and proceeds generally received from the title company.
revenueModel.evidence: Home closing proceeds are generally received from the title company within a few business days after closing.

changes.text: In 2023, the company entered the Houston market through the acquisition of Devon Street Homes.
changes.evidence: In 2023, we entered the Houston market with our acquisition of Devon Street Homes.

changes.text: In 2025, the company entered the Dallas-Fort Worth and Alabama Gulf Coast markets through organic expansion.
changes.evidence: In 2025, we entered the Dallas-Fort Worth and the Alabama Gulf Coast markets through organic expansion.
